title: Data-adaptive Safety Rules for Training Reward Models

bias_targets.target: Unfairness and bias (including racial and gender bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the 'Unfairness and bias' (UB) subset of the SafetyBench benchmark, which uses multiple-choice questions to assess the safety and alignment of language models. Additionally, the paper evaluates bias implicitly by testing the reward model's adherence to dynamically selected safety rules that explicitly forbid stereotypes, racism, sexism, and discriminatory notions.
